objective: Discover evidence-backed anomalies and hypotheses that are not adequately covered by approved fraud patterns.
exploration_guidance: Start with a bounded random sample instead of only top-risk subjects.
Generate falsifiable hypotheses, test them, and actively seek counterexamples.
Vary populations and time windows across runs to improve discovery coverage.
stopping_conditions: No sampled anomaly supports an evidence-backed lead.
The maximum turn budget is reached.
The maximum discovery count is reached.
